products.summary: LiDAR mower rated for a quarter acre that maps and navigates with a spinning 3D LiDAR and a front camera instead of an RTK antenna, so it keeps working under trees, beside the house and inside a fenced yard where satellite mowers lose their fix. Cuts from 1.2 to 3.9 in, which covers tall-cut grasses like St. Augustine and fescue. At $1,049 it is $50 under the Navimow i210 AWD, $350 under the Dreame A3 AWD 1000 and $450 under the ECOVACS GOAT O1000 LiDAR PRO.
products.fit: Flat or gently sloped quarter-acre lots with shade, fences or a house close by, where an RTK mower would drop signal. Owners who will spend an hour mapping and marking no-go zones once.
caveats: Week-one rescues are common: New Atlas needed about 25 rescues on day one until it mapped no-go zones around a 2-in ledge, shrubs and a driveway lip, then ran 12-plus hours with none.

Obstacle detection is the main reviewer complaint: inside digital saw it drive into large flat objects, and Notebookcheck found small objects were only caught at the most sensitive setting. Turn sensitivity up and leave Obstacle Avoidance on Edges enabled.
Rear-wheel drive with front casters digs in on soft or sandy soil and side slopes; for roots and hills choose an AWD mower.
Measured edge strip was about 4 in in one test despite the 2-in claim; expect to trim around fences and the dock.
Runtime per charge is 60–80 min, so a full quarter acre takes several charge cycles across a day.

products.summary: Same LiDAR-plus-camera platform as the Ultra 1000 with a bigger 5 Ah battery, a half-acre rating and the 4G tracking module included. AppleInsider tested this model on a four-zone yard and scored it 4 of 5, noting it trims within about 2 in of edges and handled rain, but spun and dug on a dip and a side slope on the first run.
products.fit: Quarter-acre to half-acre lots that are mostly flat, where the owner wants fewer charge cycles per mow and built-in 4G tracking.
caveats: Rear-wheel drive: loose soil and side slopes can cause sliding and tread marks (AppleInsider).
Trimming is still needed around fences, the dock and other fixed obstacles.
The 4G Link service is free for one year; renewal cost is not stated on the product page.
